title: Macro Faction Entity Directory (macro_factions/<id>/data.json)
description: Schema for authored Macro Faction entries. Per the Project Halcyon design doc, a Macro Faction is the highest-level cultural-political identity in the world (Karnish, Veranthi, Sethrai, Halcyon being the four canonical for the flagship game). Macros are composed of Sub-Factions; macro-level state rolls up from sub-faction state, but macros themselves carry identity, culture, primary biome affinity, and player reputation independently.

culture.description: Primary culture URN. Macro Factions are usually mono-cultural at the macro level (Karnish macro = karnish culture); polyglot situations are modeled as the Macro carrying multiple cultures via the optional culture_pool field.

culture_pool.description: Optional. Multi-culture Macro Factions (rare; the Halcyon macro is an example, mixing arcadian with assimilated locals over time). Overrides 'culture' when present. Includes the primary culture as its first entry by convention.

tech_baseline.description: Tech tier of this macro overall. Sub-Factions may diverge slightly. Used by Global Faction Events for tier-scaled impact (e.g., Pattern Sickness outbreaks hit pre-industrial macros harder).

biome_affinity.description: Biomes this Macro Faction's Sub-Factions tend to settle in (per the Biome-to-Macro Mapping rule). Worldgen places macros and their sub-factions in these biomes by preference.

macro_attitudes.description: Default macro-to-macro relationship attitudes. Roll up from sub-faction-level attitudes but provide a coarse default at world start.

player_reputation_initial.description: Initial player reputation with this Macro Faction at world start, in [-1, 1]. Sub-Faction reputations may diverge from macro reputation over play.

rollup_strategy.description: How sub-faction State Vector values aggregate into macro-level state. weighted_average uses sub-faction Reach as weights (default). dominant_member uses the strongest sub-faction's values directly (used by hegemonic macros).

is_player_macro.description: True for the macro the player belongs to (Halcyon in the flagship game). Special handling for visibility (full internal visibility), Storyteller framing (player events fire at this macro's sub-factions preferentially), and recruitment defaults.

lore.description: Macro-level lore. Sub-Faction lore is layered on top per sub-faction.
